title: Where does it go wrong?
instruction: Each set of instructions failed one test. Tap the step that caused the bug.
debrief: The bug hides in a step that didn't expect a tricky input: zero, nothing at all, an edge. Find that step, fix it and then run all the tests again.

items.label: Launch countdown · test: counting down from 5 in twos → the rocket never launches

segments.text: repeat until time is 0: change time by -2
segments.why: Time goes 5, 3, 1, -1… and skips zero. It is never exactly 0, so the loop never ends. It should be “until time is 0 or less”.

items.label: Grade average · test: no grades → the program crashes

segments.text: divide the sum by the number of grades
segments.why: No grades means dividing by zero. The instructions must first check whether there are any grades.

segments.text: write the result on the school report

items.label: Cinema entry for 15 and over · test: Tomáš is exactly 15 → he isn't let in

segments.text: is the age greater than 15? If yes, let them in
segments.why: “15 and over” includes exactly 15. The right check is “15 or more”. The edge is the most common place for a bug.

segments.text: otherwise say the film is for 15 and over

items.label: Club sign-up · test: empty name → a person with no name is saved to the list

segments.text: read the name from the form
save the name to the list
segments.why: Before saving, there's no check that the field isn't empty. Empty input is a tricky case.
